verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party developer docs describe webhooks that send HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed [linear-docs-51]. Webhooks can be registered programmatically via the webhookCreate GraphQL mutation with a team ID (or allPublicTeams) and a callback URL [linear-docs-52], which squarely meets the registrable outbound HTTP callback requirement. Missing for 10: details on event-type filtering, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
